sections.content: Use the conditional to discuss hypothetical financial decisions: *invertiría*, *ahorraría*, compraría, cambiaría. Use si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional for imagined situations.

items.spanish: Ahorraría más si tuviera un salario mayor.
items.english: I would save more if I had a higher salary.

items.spanish: Si tuviera más dinero, invertiría una parte.
items.english: If I had more money, I would invest part of it.
What would you do if you lost your job?
I would not risk all my money.

sections.content: English 'would' can mean either a past habit or a hypothetical result, but Spanish never confuses the two: the conditional ending *-ría* (*invertiría*, *ahorraría*) always signals the hypothetical outcome here, not something you used to do.
